defaults.about_intro: Hi, my name is David VanDyke, and I've lived in West Michigan my entire life. This community means the world to me, and I'm passionate about helping the people around me protect the things they love most.
defaults.about_personal: When I'm not helping clients, I enjoy watching sports (Go Blue!), collecting fountain pens, and reading books beside a cozy fire. Most of all, I love spending time with my wife, Caroline, and our four wonderful children—Weston, August, Callum, and Charlotte. Whether it's enjoying the beauty of West Michigan or cheering on my favorite team, I'm grateful to call this place home.
defaults.about_shield: Shield is an independent agency with a long track record of serving Michigan families. I'm proud to be part of those strong client relationships, and I can compare options across a broad marketplace of carriers to match coverage and budgets with confidence.

services.headline: Coverage for Restaurants & Bars
services.intro: Protect your business, your staff, and your customers with the right insurance package.

items.title: General Liability
items.desc: Covers customer injuries, property damage, and legal defense costs.

items.title: Liquor Liability
items.desc: Required if you serve alcohol. Covers claims arising from intoxicated patrons.

items.title: Property Insurance
items.desc: Protects your building, kitchen equipment, furniture, and inventory.

items.title: Workers' Compensation
items.desc: Covers employee injuries — essential in a high-risk kitchen environment.

items.title: Business Interruption
items.desc: Replaces lost income if a fire, flood, or other disaster forces you to close temporarily.

items.q: Do I need liquor liability insurance?
items.a: Yes, if you serve alcohol. Michigan law holds you responsible for damages caused by intoxicated patrons you served.

items.q: What does restaurant insurance typically cost?
items.a: It varies based on your revenue, number of employees, and whether you serve alcohol. I compare multiple carriers to find the best rate.

items.q: Does my policy cover food spoilage?
items.a: It can. I'll make sure your property policy includes food spoilage coverage so you're protected if equipment fails.

items.q: Can you cover my food truck too?
items.a: Yes. I can set up a commercial auto and GL policy for food trucks and mobile food operations.
